title: Tribes block coordinate embedding
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $s$ and a block index $i 	ext{ in } 	ext{Fin}(s)$, the map from $	ext{Fin}(w)$ to $	ext{Fin}(sw)$ sends each within-block coordinate $o$ to the coordinate corresponding to the pair $(i,o)$ under the standard product-coordinate equivalence. This map is injective.
